statement: The report states that the synthetic issuer opened its facility in Shanghai.
Revenue increased from $1,000 in 2023 to $1,200 in 2024.
Under US GAAP, the recognition rule required a public issuer on 2024-12-31 to recognize revenue when the performance obligation was satisfied.
Under US GAAP, a public issuer on 2024-12-31 recognized revenue after the performance obligation was satisfied, and revenue increased from $1,000 in 2023 to $1,200 in 2024.
